name: shared-interaction-contract

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them, with ajv and ajv-formats added to the external dependencies (the tests validate with them). The tests also read files elsewhere: the artifact tests compare the published OpenAPI document and step schemas under apps/docs-site/public/interaction, the docs page (formatted with the repo's Oxfmt config, hence `oxfmt` and `.oxfmtrc.json`) and the stable-surface registry with what the contract generates. Without these entries a change to one of those files would replay a cached pass.

contract-export.description: Write the Interaction API contract's published files: the bundled OpenAPI 3.1 document and one JSON Schema per step under apps/docs-site/public/interaction/, and the docs page apps/docs-site/src/content/docs/reference/interaction-api.md. The stable-surface check runs it and fails on drift.
